module: Flowgraph node "Drift Bounds" (category repeat_instant, drift). Uses a sites file (sitesPath pin) to create the bounds of the drift mission via gameplay_drift_bounds.setBounds.
notes: The path is resolved with mgr:getRelativeAbsolutePath; nothing is done if it is invalid.
Called every frame as long as the node is reached.

work.desc: Resolves the sites file path then calls gameplay_drift_bounds.setBounds(file).
